note: כסלח records the consonantal stem of the gentilic. Its etymology is unknown.
summary: כַּסְלֻחִים names a people descended from Mizraim. Both genealogies place them immediately after the Pathrusim.

senses.definition: A people counted among the descendants of Mizraim.

evidence.note: The Casluhim follow the Pathrusim among the peoples whom Mizraim fathered.
The parallel genealogy again lists the Casluhim after the Pathrusim.
